shots.what: Above a sea of clouds at dusk, two immortal peaks face each other; a white-robed sword immortal stands on one, a black-robed demon on the other; lightning flickers in the storm.
shots.ambient: howling gale, rolling thunder, whistling sword energies
shots.music: low epic strings, deep taiko drums and sparse guzheng plucks

shots.what: the two figures leap and clash mid-air, swords colliding; a ring-shaped shockwave erupts, the left peak cracks, debris flies.
shots.ambient: deafening clang of colliding swords, thunderous shockwave, tumbling boulders
shots.music: fierce taiko drumming and sharp erhu strokes

shots.what: the immortal forms hand seals; his sword splits into a thousand flying swords forming a colossal golden blade above the cloud sea.
shots.ambient: rising sword qi hum, crackling lightning
shots.music: swelling brass and rapid guzheng arpeggios

shots.what: the colossal sword descends like a falling star and pierces the demon's black vortex; the barrier shatters in a spiderweb of cracks.
shots.music: thundering full-orchestra climax with war drums and a crashing gong

shots.what: the explosion fades, the right peak splits and crumbles into the abyss; the immortal lands alone on the remaining cliff.
shots.ambient: fading rumble, distant avalanche, calm wind
shots.music: sparse guzheng and soft strings, solemn resolution
